description: Figure 2 illustrates the relationship between learned attribute weights and self-reported preferences for GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models, both before and after introspection training. The horizontal axis represents learned attribute weights, labeled with a linear scale ranging from -100 to 100. The vertical axis represents reported accuracy (or self-reported preferences), labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.00.  Four sets of bars are displayed, each corresponding to a specific condition: “Control” (blue), “Before Introspection Training” (orange), “After Introspection Training” (green), and “GPT-4o-mini” (purple). Each set contains two bars, one for GPT-4 and one for GPT-4o-mini. The bars are arranged in pairs, grouped by condition, with GPT-4 bars appearing before GPT-4o-mini bars within each group. The “Control” bars have approximate heights of 0.75 for GPT-4 and 0.70 for GPT-4o-mini. The “Before Introspection Training” bars have approximate heights of 0.70 for GPT-4 and 0.65 for GPT-4o-mini. The “After Introspection Training” bars have approximate heights of 0.75 for GPT-4 and 0.70 for GPT-4o-mini. The “GPT-4o-mini” bars have approximate heights of 0.50 for GPT-4 and 0.55 for GPT-4o-mini. Error bars are included for each bar, indicating 95% HDIs. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order.
